title: The porcelain monsoon
alt: A blue-and-white porcelain city sits beneath supported cloud sculptures and delicate ceramic rain.
description: An elaborate miniature city unifies architectural detail, waterways and a sculptural canopy in one ceramic material.
prompt: An intricate gallery sculpture of a rainy city made entirely from blue-and-white porcelain, displayed on a complete round white pedestal. Layered roofs, narrow alleyways, tiny arched bridges and glazed rippling canals create a dense miniature city. Delicate porcelain rain streaks descend from a cloud-shaped canopy supported by slender ceramic columns at the perimeter. Every element visibly has ceramic glaze; no floating unsupported roofs. Three-quarter elevated product photograph, clean pale-grey backdrop, soft side light, no people or letters.
